$comment: Requirement IDs: ADV-REU-01, ASM-04, PGM-09, GOV-MIN-03, XCUT-08 | Single source: design_documents/design_plans/DP-G-assembly-advisory-tooling.md §6 | Schema for contracts/component-catalog.json (RES-04 validation target). Owned by M04.
title: ComponentCatalog
description: Single source of truth for chassis component metadata, shared by ASM (dir copy + requires_* resolution), ADV (prompt catalog injection) and PGM Stage 4 (module emphasis advisory). Never duplicate the component list elsewhere.

$id.description: Catalog self-identification per DP-G §6 canonical shape.

version.description: Catalog SemVer — consumers pin MAJOR; new sub-component = MINOR (additive); rename = MAJOR.

components.description: Exactly twelve top-level chassis components in canonical order (DP-G §6 table).

id.description: Top-level component id — mirrors assembly-manifest.schema.json enum's 12 parent ids.

description.description: One-line description injected into the ADV prompt via {{catalog}} (ADV-REU-01); must stay domain-free (GOV-REU-02).

requires_env.description: Env var names required when this component is included. Single place these are declared; ASM-04 copies into manifest at assembly time (DOCTOR-REU-01 reads manifest, never catalog).

requires_providers.description: Provider/service names required when included (e.g. openai). Used by PROV-01 disclosure and COST/TRACK.

depends_on.description: Top-level component ids this component requires. ASM resolves the dependency closure from this field (ASM-AC-01); ADV must not propose a component whose depends_on entries are excluded.

gov_min_hint.description: GOV-MIN justification hint from DP-G §6 table — smallest-viable rationale for include/exclude.

sub_components.description: Slash-form sub-component ids (6.17 granularity) enumerated for filter-copy; empty for leaf components.

ships_in_app.description: Does this component's SOURCE run inside the shipped application? Authoring/pipeline tooling is false. Consumed by the disclosure generator to decide which reused blocks get a capability bullet. Optional: absent means fall back to the generator's default set.

disclosure_capability.description: One plain-English clause describing what this reused code does, with no repository name, no module id and no requirement codes. This is the exact text disclosure.md prints. Optional: absent means the generator derives a clause from `description`.

$comment.description: Provenance/requirement header carried by the catalog file itself.
